title: Scene identity × time Mirror field
hypothesis: A rank-4 multiplicative scene × time code over a shared spatial basis predicts held-out scene-time cells at lower serialized bytes than independent fields and more accurately than a matched additive scene+time code; Mirror-specific value requires beating algebraically equivalent native rank-4 tensor factorization.
physical_object: Shared spatial basis over a one-dimensional synthetic radiance field
mirror_coordinate: Rank-4 multiplicative scene coefficient × time coefficient code
logical_multiplicity: Scene-specific time-varying scalar fields evaluated at held-out scene-time combinations
controls_required: Independent dense field payload for every scene-time cell (oracle upper-quality/storage control)
Native rank-4 scene × time × spatial tensor factorization
Rank-4 additive scene + time shared-basis code
Rank-4 multiplicative Mirror scene × time shared-basis code

data_generation.structure: Four smooth shared spatial atoms with multiplicative scene and time coefficients plus a small scene-time-private residual
data_generation.observed_cells: Deterministic 4-of-6 timestamps per scene, cyclic schedule; every scene and timestamp appears in training, remaining 16 cells are held out
data_generation.fresh_lock: Seeds and held-out cell schedule frozen before generation/evaluation

optimization.amendment: 01; selected only from development seeds after observed optimizer instability; initially opened fresh seeds are excluded and preserved.

storage.authority: Actual compressed NPZ serialized inference payload bytes
paid_objects: all independently stored cell fields for upper control
storage.excluded: Training observations and optimizer state are not inference payload

compute.runtime: CPU wall clock is descriptive only

quality.metric: Held-out scene-time cell normalized RMSE over all 96 spatial samples
quality.success_gate: Screening only: Mirror nRMSE <= 0.05 in all fresh seeds and at least 25% fewer bytes than independent full-cell payload
quality.mirror_specific_gate: Mirror beats native rank-4 factorization by >1e-6 nRMSE or 1% bytes; exact algebraic aliases fail this gate
quality.failure_gate: Fails synthetic quality gate in at least 2/3 fresh seeds or is matched by native factorization/additive control

boundaries: Synthetic mechanism screen only; no C-NGP, K-Planes, radiance rendering, real scene, PSNR, or FPS claim.
Native rank-4 tensor factorization is algebraically equivalent by construction and is a mandatory attribution control.
Private residual in generator bounds extrapolation; independent-cell oracle is not a deployable held-out predictor.
Amendment 01 excludes preliminary fresh seeds 90211/90213/90219; confirmatory fresh seeds are 90221/90223/90229.

facts: Actual compressed NPZ payload is 2461–2464 B versus 17638–17682 B for independent dense full-cell oracle; about 86.0% fewer bytes.
Native rank-4 control exactly aliases Mirror predictions, payload, and MAC proxy.
Mirror query MAC proxy 392 versus dense 96; two of three fresh seeds fail nRMSE <= .05.
decision.interpretation: Scoped synthetic FAIL for the quality gate and Mirror-specific value; low bytes reflect native rank-4 separability in this generator.
decision.hypothesis: Whether a real multiscene field benefits from scene×time Mirror coordinates remains untested.
